title: Configuring the Microsoft Intune Assets Connector

blocks.text: Microsoft Intune is a cloud-based endpoint management solution. It manages user access to organizational resources and simplifies app and device management across your devices, including mobile devices, desktop computers, and virtual endpoints.
This stream retrieves Microsoft Intune devices that are mapped to assets in the system.
For the Microsoft Intune Audit Events connector, see Configuring the Microsoft Intune Audit Events Connector.
Before getting started, ensure that your tenant has an active Microsoft Intune subscription. If it does not, refer to the Microsoft documentation to activate it.
If you already have a SecOps app for API, assign the application roles. This does not apply to the SAML application. To set up the Microsoft Intune Assets connector:

blocks.item: Register an application

Before you create a new app role, ensure that you sign in to the Microsoft Entra admin center as a Cloud Application Administrator or greater admin role. To learn more, refer to the Microsoft documentation.
To learn more, see Zscaler UVM and Microsoft Services Deployment Guide.
Declare roles for an application
To declare roles for an application, refer to the Microsoft documentation.
In the Create app role window, configure the following:
Display name: Enter a name.
Allowed member types: Select Applications.
Value: Enter DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All.
Description: Enter a description.
Do you want to enable this app role?: Select the checkbox.
Assign app roles
To assign app roles to applications, refer to the Microsoft documentation.
For step 6, if your application is not found on the My APIs tab, it might be located on the APIs my organization uses tab.
For step 7, select the Avalor - read devices role.
To grant admin consent, refer to the Microsoft documentation.

blocks.text: To configure the Microsoft Intune Assets connector, you need the source authentication configuration. The following parameters are required:

blocks.item: Directory (tenant) ID and Application (client) ID
After the registration process is complete, the Microsoft Azure portal displays the app registration Overview page. From the Overview page, save the Application (client) ID and Directory (tenant) ID.
Client Secret
To add a client secret, refer to the Microsoft documentation. When you are asked to select an expiration date, select 24 months.
Save the client secret value. The client secret is not displayed again after you leave this page.

blocks.text: To create the Microsoft Intune Assets data source in the Zscaler Security Operations (SecOps) platform:

blocks.item: Go to Configure > Sources.
Click Create.
Search for and select the connector tile from the available data sources.
See image.

blocks.text: After you create the Microsoft Intune Assets data source, enter the Authentication information in the source setup Retrieval section. To configure authentication:

blocks.item: In the Authentication section, click Create New.
The Microsoft Intune Authentication window appears.
In the Microsoft Intune Authentication window, enter the information from the Prerequisites section.
See image.
Click Create.

blocks.text: To learn more, see Configuring Authentications and Managing Authentications.
For complete configuration instructions, see Creating Data Sources.
If you are still getting an authorization error after following the steps, assign the role app permissions through the Microsoft APIs tab.

blocks.item: View instructions.
Log in to the Microsoft Azure portal.
On the home page, in the Search resources, services, and docs (G+/) field, enter App registrations. From the drop-down menu, select App registrations.
On the App registrations page, select your app registration.
From the left-side navigation, from the Manage drop-down menu, select API permissions.
On the API permissions tab, click Add a permission.
On the Microsoft APIs tab, click the Microsoft Graph tile.
Select Application permissions.
Select DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All.
Click Add permissions.
To grant admin consent, refer to the Microsoft documentation.
After completing the steps, rerun the connector in the platform. Hover over the Microsoft Intune Assets data source and click Process Now.
